frase_gancho.texto: A wardrobe that was kept in closed rooms for decades.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: At the back of the garden, part of Frida’s wardrobe is on display. Diego Rivera asked that her bathroom and other rooms of the house be kept closed after her death. The museum began to open them in two thousand four. Out of them came dresses, corsets, medicines, and documents. The selection of garments can change with each exhibition, and that is how you will see it today in the display cases.
